title: Version-Specific Modern Swift and Ecosystem Topics
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of version-specific modern swift and ecosystem topics in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 22: Version-Specific Modern Swift and Ecosystem Topics. Lessons in order: Swift 6 Language Mode and Strict Concurrency; Current Swift Package Manager and Swift Build; The Subprocess Library; Modern Memory and Collection APIs; Advanced Diagnostics and Compiler Configuration; Modern Swift Interoperability; Embedded and WebAssembly Ecosystem Updates; Tracking Swift's Evolution.
